glowthread-ui-title: Heading of the comment section shown below wiki articles.
glowthread-ui-sort-label: Screen-reader label for the tabs in the comment section header that change the sort order. See {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-sort-hot}} and {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-sort-new}}.
glowthread-ui-sort-hot: Tab label in the comment section header. Sorts the comments so the most popular come first. Keep it short.
glowthread-ui-sort-new: Tab label in the comment section header. Sorts the comments with the newest first. Keep it short.
glowthread-ui-composer-placeholder: Placeholder text in the empty box for writing a new comment.
glowthread-ui-reply-placeholder:
Placeholder text in the reply box that opens below a comment.
* $1 - user name of the author of the comment being answered
See also {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-reply-placeholder-plain}}.
glowthread-ui-reply-placeholder-plain: Placeholder text in the reply box when the author of the comment being answered is hidden. Used instead of {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-reply-placeholder}}.
glowthread-ui-send:
Button label below the comment box. Posts the comment or reply. Keep it short.
{{Identical|Send}}
glowthread-ui-sending: Replaces {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-send}} on the button while the comment is being posted. Keep it short.
glowthread-ui-send-hint: Hint shown below the comment box on wide screens while the box has focus. Ctrl and ⌘ (the Command key on Mac) are key names, keep them unchanged.
glowthread-ui-cancel:
Button label that closes a reply box, or an inline confirmation (deleting a comment, changing the comment state of a page), without doing anything.
{{Identical|Cancel}}
glowthread-ui-emoji: Screen-reader label for the smiley button below the comment box that opens the emoji picker. Also the label of the picker popover and of its tab group.
glowthread-ui-emoji-tab-emoji:
Tab label in the emoji picker for emoji pictures. Keep it short.
See also {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-emoji-tab-kaomoji}}.
glowthread-ui-emoji-tab-kaomoji:
Tab label in the emoji picker for kaomoji, Japanese-style faces made of text characters, like (^_^). Keep it short.
See also {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-emoji-tab-emoji}}.
glowthread-ui-mention: Screen-reader label for the @ button below the comment box. It types @ so the writer can mention another user by name.
glowthread-ui-mention-list: Screen-reader label for the list of suggested user names that appears while the writer types @ and a name in the comment box.
glowthread-ui-mention-active:
Screen-reader-only announcement of the highlighted @mention suggestion while the reader moves through the list with the arrow keys.

Parameters:
* $1 - user name
* $2 - position of the suggestion
* $3 - number of suggestions
glowthread-ui-mention-added:
Screen-reader-only announcement after the writer picked a user from the @mention suggestions. The name is now a mention in the comment box (it is also highlighted) and that user will be notified.
* $1 - user name
See also {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-mention-removed}}.
glowthread-ui-mention-removed:
Screen-reader-only announcement when a mention in the comment box turned back into plain text (the writer removed it with Backspace or changed its name), so nobody will be notified.
* $1 - user name
See also {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-mention-added}}.
glowthread-ui-mention-units:
Screen-reader-only description of the comment box while it holds mentions picked from the @mention suggestions (highlighted on screen). Those users will be notified.
* $1 - their user names, joined by {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-list-separator}}
glowthread-ui-posted: Screen-reader only status, announced after a comment was posted and is visible to everyone.
glowthread-ui-posted-held: Toast message, also announced to screen readers, after a comment was posted but held for review by a moderator (for example because the account is new). Only the author and moderators can see it until it is approved.
glowthread-ui-like-label:
Screen-reader label for the like button under a comment. The button itself shows a heart icon and the number.
* $1 - current number of likes
glowthread-ui-like-count:
Screen-reader label for the like count under a comment when the reader cannot like it (their own comment, a removed comment, or no right to like).
* $1 - number of likes
Supports PLURAL.
glowthread-ui-like-login: Toast message when a logged-out reader presses the like button. The toast has a {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-login}} button.
glowthread-ui-like-new-account:
Toast message when a reader whose account is still in the new-account gate presses the like button, and the error when the server refuses a like for that reason (error code newaccount). The gate lets an account through once it is old enough or has enough visible comments (one by default).
See also {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-like-login}}.
glowthread-ui-login:
Button that opens the login page. Shown in toasts that ask the reader to log in, and next to {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-gate-login}} in place of the comment box.
{{Identical|Log in}}
glowthread-ui-reply:
Button label under a comment that opens a reply box. Keep it short.
{{Identical|Reply}}
glowthread-ui-reply-login: Toast message when a logged-out reader presses {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-reply}}. The toast has a {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-login}} button.
glowthread-ui-reply-to:
Shown next to or below the author name of a reply, to say whose comment it answers.
* $1 - user name of the author of the comment being answered
glowthread-ui-reply-to-removed: Shown instead of {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-reply-to}} when the comment being answered was removed or its author is hidden.
glowthread-ui-replies-show:
Link under a comment whose replies are folded (on phones, or after {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-replies-hide}}). Shows the replies in place, under the comment.
* $1 - number of replies not shown
Supports PLURAL.
glowthread-ui-replies-more:
Link after the replies shown under a comment. Loads and shows the next replies in place.
* $1 - number of replies not shown yet
Supports PLURAL.
glowthread-ui-replies-hide: Link after the replies of a conversation the reader opened. Folds the replies again, leaving {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-replies-show}}.
glowthread-ui-menu-label: Screen-reader label for the three-dot button on each comment that opens its actions menu (copy link, report, delete, moderation).
glowthread-ui-copy-link: Item in the actions menu of a comment. Copies a permanent link to the comment.
glowthread-ui-link-copied: Toast message after the link to a comment was copied.
glowthread-ui-link-copy-failed: Error toast when the browser did not allow copying the link to a comment.
glowthread-ui-report: Item in the actions menu of a comment. Opens the report form ({{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-report-title}}).
glowthread-ui-reported: Shown instead of {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-report}} in the actions menu when the reader already reported this comment.
glowthread-ui-delete:
Item in the actions menu of the reader's own comment, and the button that confirms {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-delete-confirm}}. Deletes the reader's own comment.
{{Identical|Delete}}
glowthread-ui-delete-confirm: Question shown inline below the reader's own comment after choosing {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-delete}}, with {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-cancel}} and {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-delete}} buttons. Also the screen-reader label of this confirmation area.
glowthread-ui-deleted-own: Toast message after the reader deleted their own comment.
glowthread-ui-mod-label: Heading of the moderator part of the actions menu of a comment. Only moderators see it.
glowthread-ui-pin: Moderator item in the actions menu of a top-level comment. Pins the comment to the top of the list.
glowthread-ui-unpin: Moderator item in the actions menu of a pinned comment. Removes the pin.
glowthread-ui-approve: Moderator button and menu item for a comment awaiting review. Makes the comment visible to everyone.
glowthread-ui-hide: Moderator button and menu item, also in the bulk action bar. Hides the comment from readers. It can be shown again with {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-restore}}.
glowthread-ui-restore:
Moderator button and menu item, also in the bulk action bar. Makes a hidden comment visible again.
{{Identical|Restore}}
glowthread-ui-dismiss: Moderator button and menu item, also in the bulk action bar. Closes the open reports on a comment and keeps the comment visible.
glowthread-ui-user-record: Moderator item in the actions menu of a comment. Opens the comment history of the comment's author on [[Special:GlowThread]].
glowthread-ui-pinned: Badge next to the author name of a pinned comment. Keep it short.
glowthread-ui-held:
Badge shown to moderators next to the author name of a comment awaiting review. Keep it short.
See also {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-chip-held}}.
glowthread-ui-held-own: Badge shown to the author next to their own comment while it awaits review. The comment is hidden from other readers until a moderator approves it. The · is a separator, keep it.
glowthread-ui-held-own-note: Note shown to the author below their own comment while it awaits review.
glowthread-ui-reported-count:
Badge shown to moderators next to the author name of a comment that has open reports.
* $1 - number of open reports
Supports PLURAL.
glowthread-ui-status-deleted: Badge shown to moderators on a hidden comment, which readers no longer see. Keep it short.
glowthread-ui-status-erased:
Badge on a comment whose text was erased for good. Keep it short.
See also {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-erased-text}}.
glowthread-ui-erased-text: Shown in place of the text of an erased comment.
glowthread-ui-floor-label:
Screen-reader label for the comment number shown as #N next to the time. Comments are numbered in posting order on each page, like floors in a Chinese forum thread.
* $1 - number of the comment on its page
glowthread-ui-user-hidden: Shown instead of the author name when the author is hidden.
glowthread-ui-mod-tools: Screen-reader label for the moderator toolbar above the comment list (review filters, page comment state, select mode).
glowthread-ui-chip-held: Filter button in the moderator toolbar. Shows only the comments awaiting review. A number follows the label. Keep it short.
glowthread-ui-chip-reported: Filter button in the moderator toolbar. Shows only the comments with open reports. A number follows the label. Keep it short.
glowthread-ui-page-state-label:
Button in the moderator toolbar that opens the page state menu.
* $1 - the current comment state of the page: {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-page-state-open}}, {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-page-state-locked}} or {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-page-state-disabled}}
glowthread-ui-page-state-menu: Heading of the menu in the moderator toolbar where moderators set the comment state of the page.
glowthread-ui-page-state-open:
Comment state of a page: everyone can post and reply. Shown in the moderator toolbar and as an option in the page state menu. Keep it short.
See also {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-page-state-open-help}}.
glowthread-ui-page-state-locked:
Comment state of a page: comments stay readable and can be liked, but nobody can post or reply. Shown in the moderator toolbar and as an option in the page state menu. Keep it short.
See also {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-page-state-locked-help}}.
glowthread-ui-page-state-disabled:
Comment state of a page: readers do not see the comment section. Shown in the moderator toolbar and as an option in the page state menu. Keep it short.
See also {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-page-state-disabled-help}}.
glowthread-ui-page-state-open-help: Help text below {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-page-state-open}} in the page state menu.
glowthread-ui-page-state-locked-help: Help text below {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-page-state-locked}} in the page state menu.
glowthread-ui-page-state-disabled-help: Help text below {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-page-state-disabled}} in the page state menu.
glowthread-ui-page-state-confirm-open: Question shown below the moderator toolbar after choosing {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-page-state-open}} in the page state menu, with {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-cancel}} and {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-page-state-apply-open}} buttons. Also the screen-reader label of this confirmation area.
glowthread-ui-page-state-confirm-locked: Question shown below the moderator toolbar after choosing {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-page-state-locked}} in the page state menu, with {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-cancel}} and {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-page-state-apply-locked}} buttons. Also the screen-reader label of this confirmation area.
glowthread-ui-page-state-confirm-disable: Question shown below the moderator toolbar after choosing {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-page-state-disabled}} in the page state menu, with {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-cancel}} and {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-page-state-apply-disabled}} buttons. Also the screen-reader label of this confirmation area.
glowthread-ui-page-state-apply-open: Button that confirms {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-page-state-confirm-open}} and opens comments on the page. A verb. Keep it short.
glowthread-ui-page-state-apply-locked: Button that confirms {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-page-state-confirm-locked}} and locks comments on the page. A verb. Keep it short.
glowthread-ui-page-state-apply-disabled: Button that confirms {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-page-state-confirm-disabled}} and closes comments on the page. A verb. Keep it short.
glowthread-ui-page-state-done-open: Toast message after a moderator opened comments on the page.
glowthread-ui-page-state-done-locked: Toast message after a moderator locked comments on the page.
glowthread-ui-page-state-done-disabled: Toast message after a moderator closed comments on the page.
glowthread-ui-manage-mode: Toggle button in the moderator toolbar. Turns on select mode, which adds a checkbox to each comment and shows the bulk action bar. Keep it short.
glowthread-ui-mod-disabled-note: Note shown to moderators at the top of the comment section when comments on the page are closed ({{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-page-state-disabled}}).
glowthread-ui-mod-held-because:
Shown to moderators below a comment awaiting review.
* $1 - the reasons the comment was held, such as {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-hold-filter}}, joined with {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-list-separator}}
glowthread-ui-mod-reported-because:
Below a reported comment, once per report reason. The text around $1 is read by screen readers only, the reason itself is shown.
* $1 - a report reason, such as {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-reason-spam}}
glowthread-ui-list-separator:
{{optional}}
Separator between the items in a list of hold reasons or report reasons. Write   for a space at the end, as in English ", ": a plain trailing space is lost.
glowthread-ui-hold-filter: Hold reason, shown after {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-mod-held-because}}: the comment matched a rule of the word filter. A short phrase used as a list item.
glowthread-ui-hold-filter-error: Hold reason, shown after {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-mod-held-because}}: the word filter failed while checking the comment, so the comment was held to be safe. A short phrase used as a list item.
glowthread-ui-hold-spamblacklist: Hold reason, shown after {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-mod-held-because}}: the comment contains a link on the spam blacklist. A short phrase used as a list item.
glowthread-ui-hold-newaccount: Hold reason, shown after {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-mod-held-because}}: the author's account is new. A short phrase used as a list item.
glowthread-ui-hold-reports: Hold reason, shown after {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-mod-held-because}}: several users reported the comment, so it was held automatically. A short phrase used as a list item.
glowthread-ui-hold-unknown: Shown after {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-mod-held-because}} when no hold reason was recorded.
glowthread-ui-mod-done-approve:
Toast message after a moderator approved comments.
* $1 - number of comments
Supports PLURAL.
glowthread-ui-mod-done-delete:
Toast message after a moderator hid comments. The toast has an {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-undo}} button.
* $1 - number of comments
Supports PLURAL.
glowthread-ui-mod-done-restore:
Toast after a moderator restored comments; restoring makes them public.
* $1 - number of comments
Supports PLURAL.
glowthread-ui-mod-done-pin: Toast message after a moderator pinned a comment. The toast has an {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-undo}} button.
glowthread-ui-mod-done-unpin: Toast message after a moderator removed the pin from a comment. The toast has an {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-undo}} button.
glowthread-ui-mod-done-dismiss:
Toast message after a moderator dismissed the reports on comments.
* $1 - number of comments
Supports PLURAL.
glowthread-ui-mod-nochange: Toast message after a moderation action when none of the comments needed a change.
glowthread-ui-mod-failed:
Error toast when a moderation action did not change some or all of the comments. When some comments did change, it is shown after the success message, for example {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-mod-done-delete}}.
* $1 - number of comments that were not changed
Supports PLURAL.
glowthread-ui-undo:
Button in the toast after a moderator hid, restored, pinned or unpinned comments. Reverses the action. Keep it short.
{{Identical|Undo}}
glowthread-ui-bulk-label: Screen-reader label for the bulk action bar shown in select mode ({{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-manage-mode}}).
glowthread-ui-bulk-selected:
Number of selected comments in the bulk action bar. Announced to screen readers when it changes.
* $1 - number of selected comments
glowthread-ui-bulk-exit: Button in the bulk action bar that leaves select mode. Keep it short.
glowthread-ui-select-comment:
Screen-reader label for the checkbox in front of each comment in select mode.
* $1 - number of the comment on its page, see {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-floor-label}}
glowthread-ui-queue-empty-held: Shown in place of the comment list when the moderator filter {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-chip-held}} is on and no comment on the page awaits review.
glowthread-ui-queue-empty-reported: Shown in place of the comment list when the moderator filter {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-chip-reported}} is on and no comment on the page has open reports.
glowthread-ui-reason-spam: Report reason. Option in the report form, also shown to moderators in report lists.
glowthread-ui-reason-abuse: Report reason: insults or attacks on a person. Option in the report form, also shown to moderators in report lists.
glowthread-ui-reason-offtopic: Report reason: the comment is not about the article it is posted under. Option in the report form, also shown to moderators in report lists.
glowthread-ui-reason-spoiler: Report reason: the comment reveals story or event details people may not want to know yet. Option in the report form, also shown to moderators in report lists.
glowthread-ui-reason-misinfo: Report reason: the comment states something wrong. Option in the report form, also shown to moderators in report lists.
glowthread-ui-reason-other:
Report reason for anything not covered by the other reasons. Option in the report form, also shown to moderators in report lists.
{{Identical|Other}}
glowthread-ui-reason-legacy: Report reason shown to moderators for reports imported from the old FlowThread extension, which did not record a reason. Not offered in the report form.
glowthread-ui-report-title: Title of the report form. It opens as a popover on wide screens and as a sheet from the bottom on small screens.
glowthread-ui-report-reason: Screen-reader label for the group of report reasons in the report form.
glowthread-ui-report-note: Label of the optional text field in the report form, where the reporter can add details. The field takes up to 500 characters.
glowthread-ui-report-submit: Submit button of the report form.
glowthread-ui-report-done: Toast message after a report was sent.
glowthread-ui-report-already: Toast message when the reader sends a report for a comment they already reported.
glowthread-ui-popular: Heading of the box of top comments shown above the comment list.
glowthread-ui-popular-line:
One top comment in the top comments strip ({{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-popular}}).
* $1 - the author's name
* $2 - the comment text, shortened to one line
glowthread-ui-list-label: Screen-reader label for the list of comments.
glowthread-ui-load-more:
Button at the end of the comment list. Loads the next comments.
{{Identical|Load more}}
glowthread-ui-loading:
Replaces {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-load-more}} on the button while more comments load.
{{Identical|Loading}}
glowthread-ui-retry: Button shown after loading failed. Tries to load again. Also replaces {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-load-more}} after loading more comments failed.
glowthread-ui-empty-title: Shown in the comment section when the page has no comments yet.
glowthread-ui-empty-invite: Shown below {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-empty-title}} to readers who can post.
glowthread-ui-empty-read: Shown below {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-empty-title}} to readers who cannot post, for example logged-out readers.
glowthread-ui-expand: Button below a long comment that is shown shortened. Shows the full text.
glowthread-ui-collapse: Button below a long comment shown in full. Shortens it again.
glowthread-ui-close:
Screen-reader label for the close button of the conversation sheet and of the report sheet.
{{Identical|Close}}
glowthread-ui-thread-title: Heading of the box above the comment list that shows the conversation of a comment opened from a link (#gt- permalink) or from {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-popular}}, when that conversation is not in the list.
glowthread-ui-time-now: Relative time of a comment posted less than a minute ago.
glowthread-ui-time-minutes:
Relative time of a comment posted less than an hour ago.
* $1 - number of minutes, 1 to 59
Supports PLURAL.
glowthread-ui-time-hours:
Relative time of a comment posted less than a day ago.
* $1 - number of hours, 1 to 23
Supports PLURAL.
glowthread-ui-time-yesterday: Relative time of a comment posted at least 24 hours ago, on the previous calendar day in the reader's time zone.
glowthread-ui-time-days:
Relative time of a comment posted 2 to 6 calendar days ago. Older comments show a date instead.
* $1 - number of days
Supports PLURAL.
glowthread-ui-gate-login: Shown to logged-out readers in place of the comment box, next to a {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-login}} button.
glowthread-ui-gate-blocked: Shown in place of the comment box to a user who is blocked from the whole wiki.
glowthread-ui-gate-blocked-page: Shown in place of the comment box to a user with a partial block that covers this page.
glowthread-ui-gate-block-reason:
Shown below {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-gate-blocked}} or {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-gate-blocked-page}} when the block has a reason.
* $1 - block reason, written by the administrator who made the block
glowthread-ui-gate-block-details: Link next to the block notice in place of the comment box. Opens [[Special:BlockList]] for the user.
glowthread-ui-gate-locked: Shown in place of the comment box when comments on the page are locked.
glowthread-ui-gate-disabled: Shown when comments on the page are closed. Readers see it in place of the whole comment section, and moderators see it in place of the comment box.
glowthread-ui-gate-ineligible: Shown in place of the comment box when comments are not available on the page, for example in a namespace without comments.
glowthread-ui-gate-rights: Shown in place of the comment box when the user's account does not have the right to post comments.
glowthread-ui-error-network: Error message when the browser could not reach the wiki server. Shown in a toast or in place of the comment list.
glowthread-ui-error-server: Error message when the server returned an error, for example an HTTP 500.
glowthread-ui-error-session: Error message when the edit token is missing or no longer valid, usually because the session expired.
glowthread-ui-error-permission: Error message when the user does not have the right for the action. Logged-out readers see {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-error-login}} instead.
glowthread-ui-error-login: Error message shown to logged-out readers instead of {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-error-permission}}.
glowthread-ui-error-blocked: Error message when a blocked user tries an action. If the block has a reason, {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-error-blocked-reason}} is used instead.
glowthread-ui-error-blocked-reason:
Error message when a blocked user tries an action.
* $1 - block reason, written by the administrator who made the block
See also {{msg-mw|glowthread-ui-error-blocked}}.
glowthread-ui-error-ratelimited: Error message when the user did the same action too often in a short time and the wait time is not known.
glowthread-ui-error-ratelimited-wait:
Error message when the user did the same action too often in a short time. Also shown below the comment box while the wait counts down.
* $1 - number of seconds to wait
Supports PLURAL.
glowthread-ui-error-readonly: Error message when the wiki is in read-only mode, for example during maintenance.
glowthread-ui-error-page-missing: Error message when the page does not exist or was deleted.
glowthread-ui-error-page-ineligible: Error message when comments are not available on the page, for example in a namespace without comments.
glowthread-ui-error-disabled: Error message when comments on the page are closed.
glowthread-ui-error-locked: Error message when comments on the page are locked.
glowthread-ui-error-empty: Error message when the user tries to send an empty comment.
glowthread-ui-error-too-long:
Error message when the comment is too long. Also shown below the comment box while the text is over the limit.
* $1 - maximum number of characters
Supports PLURAL.
glowthread-ui-error-too-many-mentions:
Error message when the comment mentions too many users with @.
* $1 - maximum number of users one comment can mention
Supports PLURAL.
glowthread-ui-error-duplicate: Error message when the user posts the same text again on the same page within a short time.
glowthread-ui-error-parent: Error message when the user replies to a comment that was removed or is not visible.
glowthread-ui-error-comment-missing: Error message when the comment acted on was removed or is not visible.
glowthread-ui-error-own-like: Error message when the user tries to like their own comment.
glowthread-ui-error-own-report: Error message when the user tries to report their own comment.
glowthread-ui-error-report-reason: Error message when the chosen report reason was turned off by the wiki after the report form was opened.
glowthread-ui-error-note-too-long: Error message when the details in the report form are longer than 500 characters.
glowthread-ui-error-not-author: Error message when a user tries to delete a comment written by someone else.
glowthread-ui-error-bad-status: Error message when a moderation action does not fit the current state of the comment, usually because the comment changed in the meantime.
glowthread-ui-error-cannot-pin: Error message when a moderator tries to pin a reply. Only top-level comments can be pinned.
glowthread-ui-error-bad-cursor: Error message when loading more comments failed because the comment list changed and the loading position is no longer valid.
glowthread-ui-error-unknown: Error message for any error that has no more specific message.
glowthread-ui-admin-nav-label: Label of the navigation of Special:GlowThread (queue, settings, links).
glowthread-ui-admin-nav-settings: Navigation item and heading: the comment settings.
glowthread-ui-admin-nav-filter: Link to the wiki page MediaWiki:GlowThread-filter, where the word-filter rules live.
glowthread-ui-admin-nav-shortcuts: Button that opens the list of keyboard shortcuts.
glowthread-ui-admin-doc-title:
Browser tab title of Special:GlowThread. The site name is appended.
* $1 - the current view, for example "Reported" or "Settings"
glowthread-ui-admin-title-user:
View title when the queue shows all comments by one user.
* $1 - user name or IP address
glowthread-ui-admin-title-page:
View title when the queue shows all comments on one page.
* $1 - page title
glowthread-ui-admin-tabs-label: Screen-reader label of the queue tabs.
glowthread-ui-admin-tab-reported: Queue tab: comments with open reports.
